suggestions.description: Add a negative regression case where ordinary verification failure output contains AUTH_REQUIRED, QUOTA_BLOCKED or MODEL_UNAVAILABLE as quoted text rather than the structured failure prefix; assert that ordinary bounded repair remains available. The current helper correctly checks the prefix, but this intended distinction deserves explicit coverage.
